nodes.description: Immutable address of the ERC20 token distributed by this contract.
Immutable merkle root of the tree containing account balances available to claim.
Packed array of booleans tracking which claim indices have already been claimed.
Constructor setting the immutable token and merkleRoot addresses.
External claim function: checks index not claimed, verifies merkle proof, marks claimed and transfers tokens.
onlyOwner function that transfers the full token balance held by this contract to a recipient.
View function returning whether a given index has already been claimed using the bitmap.
Private function that sets the claimed bit for a given index in claimedBitMap.
View function returning the token balance held by this contract.
Caller-supplied address used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier via _msgSender().
External IERC20(token).transfer(account, amount) call inside claim, transferring tokens to a caller-supplied account.
External IERC20(token).transfer(recipient, balance) call inside withdraw, transferring the whole contract balance.
MerkleProof.verify call validating the supplied proof against the stored merkleRoot.
Claim index parameter, used for the claimed check, bit setting and leaf construction.
Account parameter, the recipient address of the claimed tokens and part of the merkle leaf.
Amount parameter, the token amount to transfer and part of the merkle leaf.
Merkle proof array parameter validated against merkleRoot.
Recipient address parameter of withdraw, receives the contract's token balance.
Constructor parameter assigned to the immutable token state variable.
Constructor parameter assigned to the immutable merkleRoot state variable.
Local bytes32 leaf computed as keccak256(abi.encodePacked(index, account, amount)).
Local word index computed as index / 256 for bitmap lookups.
Local bit index computed as index % 256 for bitmap masking.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ flows into the constructor body.
Constructor parameter merkleRoot_ flows into the constructor body.
token_ is assigned to the immutable state variable token.
merkleRoot_ is assigned to the immutable state variable merkleRoot.
index parameter flows into the claim function body.
account parameter flows into the claim function body.
amount parameter flows into the claim function body.
merkleProof parameter flows into the claim function body.
recipient parameter flows into the withdraw function body.
index is used by isClaimed to compute the claimed word and bit.
index is used by _setClaimed to set the claimed bit.
claimedBitMap storage is read inside isClaimed.
claimedBitMap storage is read and written inside _setClaimed.
token address is used as the target of the external transfer call in claim.
token address is used as the target of the external transfer call in withdraw.
merkleRoot is passed to MerkleProof.verify as the trusted root.
index contributes to the leaf hashed and verified against the merkle root.
account contributes to the leaf hashed and verified against the merkle root.
amount contributes to the leaf hashed and verified against the merkle root.
merkleProof is the untrusted proof array supplied to MerkleProof.verify.
local leaf node is passed as the leaf argument to MerkleProof.verify.
Caller-supplied recipient address receives the external token transfer in withdraw.
Caller-supplied account address is the destination of the external token transfer in claim.
Caller-supplied amount parameterizes the external token transfer in claim.
msg.sender is compared to _owner by the onlyOwner modifier gating withdraw.
claim invokes isClaimed to check whether the index was already claimed.
claim invokes MerkleProof.verify to validate the proof.
claim invokes _setClaimed to mark the index as claimed.
claim performs an external token transfer to the account after marking the index claimed.
withdraw performs an external token transfer of the whole contract balance to recipient.
withdraw reads the immutable token address to build transfer and balanceOf calls.
totalSupply reads the token contract balance for this contract's address.
claimedWordIndex local indexes the bitmap word read in isClaimed.
claimedBitIndex local determines the mask used in isClaimed.
local leaf node is computed and used inside the claim function.

normalization_plan.reason: index is a transient parameter of claim that directly parameterizes the claim function's checks, bit-marking and leaf hashing.
account is a transient parameter of claim that directly determines the external transfer destination.
amount is a transient parameter of claim that directly parameterizes the external token transfer.
merkleProof is a transient parameter of claim passed directly to the proof verification operation.
recipient is the only parameter of withdraw and directly determines the transfer destination.
token_ is a constructor-only parameter immediately written into the immutable token state variable.
merkleRoot_ is a constructor-only parameter immediately written into the immutable merkleRoot state variable.
node is a short-lived local leaf value computed and consumed within claim's proof verification.
claimedWordIndex is a transient local used only to index the bitmap inside isClaimed.
claimedBitIndex is a transient local used only to build the bit mask inside isClaimed.
